// Everything passes --locked: A build must never silently rewrite Cargo.lock; see the justfile.

tasks.label: check
tasks.detail: fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, and the test suite. The pre-commit gate.
tasks.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace

tasks.label: build (release)
tasks.detail: What the player runs. Asset decode is unusably slow in a debug build.

tasks.label: audit
tasks.detail: Supply-chain gate: advisories, licences, banned crates, source registries.

tasks.label: dist: windows
tasks.detail: Cross-compile daysengine.exe and package it with its DLLs. Builds the vendored SDL3 and ffmpeg first if needed.

tasks.// Playing it: A task is a shell, so it reads .env itself -- no variable has to be exported first and nothing has to be generated. This is the difference from .vscode/launch.json, where VS Code resolves ${env:...} out of its own environment before any shell exists.
tasks.label: run: School Days HQ
tasks.detail: Play School Days HQ. Opens a window and takes over the desktop.
tasks.command: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; : "${DAYS_GAME_DIR:?not set -- put it in .env, and quote the path if it has spaces}"; cargo run --locked --bin daysengine -- --game "$DAYS_GAME_DIR"

tasks.label: run: Shiny Days
tasks.detail: Play Shiny Days. Opens a window and takes over the desktop.
tasks.command: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; : "${DAYS_SHINYDAYS_DIR:?not set -- put it in .env, and quote the path if it has spaces}"; cargo run --locked --bin daysengine -- --game "$DAYS_SHINYDAYS_DIR"

tasks.label: deps
tasks.detail: Build the vendored SDL3 and ffmpeg every build links. Slow; once per checkout. Nothing compiles until this has run.

tasks.label: windows: deps
tasks.detail: Build the vendored SDL3 and ffmpeg for MinGW-w64. Slow; once per checkout.

tasks.label: dist: linux
tasks.detail: Release archive with the vendored SDL3 and LGPL ffmpeg beside the binaries.

tasks.label: dist: windows (binaries already built)
tasks.detail: Package only. Fails if the vendored libraries or the .exe files are missing.

tasks.label: android: deps
tasks.detail: Build the vendored SDL3 and ffmpeg for arm64-v8a and x86_64. Slow; once per checkout.

tasks.label: android: build
tasks.detail: A debug-signed APK in target/dist/, ready for `adb install`. The player picks their own install in the app.

tasks.label: dist: android
tasks.detail: An unsigned release APK in target/dist/, named after the commit. Sign it before installing.

tasks.// The inspection subcommands: These are the verification path. They run headless against a real install and print what they found; the game itself is not a test harness. The same binary with no subcommand opens a window instead.
tasks.label: inspect: menu
tasks.detail: Drive the menu state machine headlessly and report where each event lands.

tasks.label: inspect: menu --check-all
tasks.detail: Open every screen of the install and report which ones this engine can draw.

tasks.label: inspect: scripts
tasks.detail: Parse every .ORS and report anything the parser cannot handle.

tasks.label: inspect: assets
tasks.detail: Check that every asset path referenced by every script resolves.

inputs.description: Game directory (the one holding Packs and the game executable)

inputs.// How a screen is reached: `menu` starts at the title and is driven by events, because that is how a player reaches a screen. There is no mode argument: the state machine decides, which is the thing being verified.
inputs.description: Menu events, comma separated (down, up, enter, esc, click:X:Y, ...). Empty for the title as it opens.
